params.prompt: Stylized blocky Roblox-style cartoon game UI concept art, 16:9 landscape phone game screen, matte flat colors, thick dark outlines, rounded panels, sticker-like cards, chunky bold readable text. Strictly NO neon, NO glow, NO bloom, NO lens flare, NO emissive light, NO glossy shine. Heist-comedy tone, kid-friendly, no blood, no weapons shown. Reward state system: 7 days; claimed days have a green check stamp, today is highlighted with a dark outline and a TODAY pill, locked days have a padlock pill. Includes a close X button top-right, a streak counter, and one big CLAIM button. Title lockup 'DEAD DROP' as a sticker logo. Layout: flat warm off-white rounded panel over a blurred garage background, a 7-card grid of sticker item cards each shaped like a small locker door with a number: Day 1 '500 Credits', Day 2 'Spray Tag', Day 3 '1,000 Credits', Day 4 'Kart Decal' (TODAY), Day 5 'Ping Icons', Day 6 '2,000 Credits', Day 7 'Static Face Mask' (bigger card, gold trim). Big pill button 'CLAIM'. '3 DAY STREAK' pill. Palette: off-white, charcoal, sky blue, orange, green, pink-purple.
